key.name: client-path
key.description: Absolute path of the ClipVault binary the extension starts and gives clipboard access to. Nothing else can connect.

key.name: paste-previous-shortcut
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that asks ClipVault to paste the clip before the current one into the focused window.

key.name: allow-user-owned-client
key.description: Start the program even when your own account can modify it, as with a cargo build. Leave this off for normal use.
